import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    lT = np.log(T)
    z = p[0] + p[1]*lT + p[2]/T + p[3]*T + p[4]*L + p[5]*L**2 + p[6]*L/T + p[7]*L*lT + p[8]*L/T**2 + p[9]*L*T
    return np.exp(z)
